title: Ya Fatima Zahra (s.a)
body:
Aah, Jannatul Baqee, Aah, Jannatul Baqee
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaye the Madine mein Teri karne ziyaarat
Dil tukde hua dekh ke Bibi teri gharbat
Ab bhi hai Musalmanon ko ye tujh se adaawat
Ek shama ko mohtaaj hai Bibi teri turbat
<<DIVIDER>>
Rauza tera veeran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
Bikhraa hua Quran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya Fatima Zahra, Ya Fatima Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Haaye Zahra, Haaye Zahra, Haaye Zahra, Haaye Zahra,
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaqa ka kafan bhi abhi maila na hua tha
Darwaza jala kar tere pehlu pe giraya
Do pasliyan tooti, tera Mohsin gaya maara
Be-saakhta us waqt padha tu ne ye nauha
<<DIVIDER>>
Be-dard laeeno se bacha lijiye Baba
Hain aap hain, mujh ko bula lijiye Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Rauza tera veeran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
Bikhraa hua Quran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaad aa gayi bechargi-e-Fatah-e-Khaibar
Afsos, giraftaar-e-sitam ho gaye Haider
Chillati rahi, behr-e-madad, bint-e-Payambar
Sar pairon pe Amma ke rakhe rote the Sarwar
<<DIVIDER>>
Is zulm ke toofaan se kis kis ko nikaale
Bachchon ko sambhaale ke Ali khud ko sambhaale
<<DIVIDER>>
Rauza tera veeran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
Bikhraa hua Quran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaad aa gaya, Bibi, tera darbaar mein jaana
Baithe hain sitamgaar, khadi roti hai Zahra
Do lafz tasalli ke bhi koi nahin deta
Kya aise diya jaata hai ek baap ka pursa?
<<DIVIDER>>
Uthte the Nabi, jis ke liye, kab se khadi hai
Kam-zarf se, badbakht se, haq maang rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Rauza tera veeran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
Bikhraa hua Quran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab tak rahi duniya mein, tadapti rahi Zahra
Din raat Madine mein yahi padhti thi nauha
Seene se mujhe apne laga lijiye, Baba
Ho jaata siyaah din, pa agar waqt ye padta
<<DIVIDER>>
Zaalim, pa asar kuch nahi fariyad ka meri
Kya hoga khuda jane ab aulaad ka meri
<<DIVIDER>>
Rauza tera veeran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
Bikhraa hua Quran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Din raat isi gham mein tadapti rahi Zahra
Kya hoga, Khuda jaane, mere baad Ali ka
Chhut jaayegi kuch roz mein mujh se to ye duniya
De ga mere bachchon ko bhala kaun sahaara?
<<DIVIDER>>
Afsos, sad-afsos, safar kar gayi Zahra
Tanha hain Ali, koi nahin, mar gayi Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Rauza tera veeran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
Bikhraa hua Quran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Chhay (6) Maah bhi seh paayi na Baba ki judaai
Duniya se safar kar hi gayi gham ki sataayi
Mil hi gayi har zulm se Zahra ko rihaai
Tareekh se poochhe koi, Haider ki duhaai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab Fatima Zahra ko kafan dete the Maula
Haathon se kaleje ko pakad lete the Maula
<<DIVIDER>>
Rauza tera veeran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
Bikhraa hua Quran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Taiyaar hua jaise hi Zahra ka janaaza
Tab aakhri deedaar ko bachchon ko bulaaya
Sar pairon pe rakhte hain Hasan, padhte hain nauha
Kuch door khada rota hai Zahra ka chaheeta
<<DIVIDER>>
Tab band-e-kafan tod ke chillati hai Zahra
Aa Seene se lag ja mere, ab jaati hai Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Rauza tera veeran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
Bikhraa hua Quran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai chaaron taraf saare Madine mein ujaala
Ek qabr hai Zahra ki, jahaan par hai andhera
Turbat ko teri takta hai Sarkaar ka roza
Milti hai humein roz saza, Fatima Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Zawwaron ko ye roz saza dete hain zaalim
Rote hain to jaali se hata dete hain zaalim
<<DIVIDER>>
Rauza tera veeran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
Bikhraa hua Quran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Hum qabr pe, Bibi, teri aa bhi nahin sakte
Hum haal-e-judaai ka suna bhi nahin sakte
Jo dil pe guzarti hai, bata bhi nahin sakte
Do ashk tere gham mein baha bhi nahin sakte
<<DIVIDER>>
Turbat ka nishaan bhi ye mitaane pe ade hain
Hum door hain, nazdeek ye shaitaan khade hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Rauza tera veeran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
Bikhraa hua Quran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Utha shab-e-taariki mein Zahra ka janaaza
Kuch logon se naraaz gayin Fatima Zahra
Aaye jo Ali le ke Baqaiye mein janaaza
Tab qabr se aayi ye sada, laadli aaja
<<DIVIDER>>
La de de Ali, meri amaanat mujhe de de
Bachchon ko sambhaal, aur ye mayyat mujhe de de
<<DIVIDER>>
Rauza tera veeran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
Bikhraa hua Quran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaamosh khade rote hain sab haaye azaadaar
Matam na teri qabr pe kar paaye azaadaar
Mitti na teri qabr ki chhoo paaye azaadaar
Ye zakhm Madine se naye laaye azaadaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis Tarha se loota hai Muhammad ke chaman ko
Maa, qabr ko mohtaaj hai Shabbir kafan ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Rauza tera veeran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
Bikhraa hua Quran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Har ek yahi keh ke dua ghar ko hai lauta
Aa jaiye, aa jaiye, aa jaiye, Aaqa
Le lijiye shaitaanon se mazlooma ka badla
Aap aayein to taiyaar ho Masooma ka Rauza
<<DIVIDER>>
In saare Yazeedon ko zamaane se mita do
Phir farsh-e-aza saare Madine mein bichha do
<<DIVIDER>>
Rauza tera veeran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
Bikhraa hua Quran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya aur RAZA likhe, ke tukde hai kaleja
Rauza tera, Tayyaar ho, Ya Fatima Zahra
ARSHAD padhe khud aa ke Baqee mein ye nauha
De saare azaadaar tere laal ko pursa
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai jitne Fadak-khor, woh dozakh mein jalenge
Jannat mein faqat Shah ke azaadaar rahenge
<<DIVIDER>>
Rauza tera veeran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
Bikhraa hua Quran hai, Ya Fatima Zahra
author: Raza Sirsivi
